ai_logs_values_check.name: ai_logs_values_check
ai_logs_values_check.value: "ai_logs"."reserved_usd" >= 0 and ("ai_logs"."cost_usd" is null or "ai_logs"."cost_usd" >= 0) and "ai_logs"."duration_ms" >= 0 and "ai_logs"."images" >= 0 and "ai_logs"."categories" >= 0 and "ai_logs"."accounts" >= 0 and "ai_logs"."transactions" >= 0 and ("ai_logs"."input_tokens" is null or "ai_logs"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("ai_logs"."output_tokens" is null or "ai_logs"."output_tokens" >= 0)

assets_manual_price_check.name: assets_manual_price_check
assets_manual_price_check.value: ("assets"."manual_price" is null) = ("assets"."manual_price_at" is null) and ("assets"."manual_price" is null or "assets"."manual_price" > 0)

categories_group_check.name: categories_group_check
categories_group_check.value: case "categories"."kind" when 'expense' then "categories"."group" in ('needs', 'wants') when 'income' then "categories"."group" in ('active', 'passive', 'other') else "categories"."group" = 'financial' end

debts_accounts_check.name: debts_accounts_check
debts_accounts_check.value: ("debts"."kind" = 'card_installment') = ("debts"."card_account_id" is not null) and ("debts"."kind" = 'card_installment') = ("debts"."pay_from_account_id" is null)

goal_contribution_plans_months_check.name: goal_contribution_plans_months_check
goal_contribution_plans_months_check.value: extract(day from "goal_contribution_plans"."start_month") = 1 and ("goal_contribution_plans"."end_month" is null or (extract(day from "goal_contribution_plans"."end_month") = 1 and "goal_contribution_plans"."end_month" >= "goal_contribution_plans"."start_month"))

goal_funding_sources_amount_check.name: goal_funding_sources_amount_check
goal_funding_sources_amount_check.value: ("goal_funding_sources"."mode" = 'fixed') = ("goal_funding_sources"."amount_minor" is not null) and ("goal_funding_sources"."amount_minor" is null or "goal_funding_sources"."amount_minor" > 0)

goal_funding_sources_mode_check.name: goal_funding_sources_mode_check
goal_funding_sources_mode_check.value: ("goal_funding_sources"."account_id" is null or "goal_funding_sources"."mode" in ('whole', 'fixed')) and ("goal_funding_sources"."asset_id" is null or "goal_funding_sources"."mode" <> 'fixed')

goal_funding_sources_pct_check.name: goal_funding_sources_pct_check
goal_funding_sources_pct_check.value: ("goal_funding_sources"."pct_bps" is not null) = ("goal_funding_sources"."asset_id" is not null and "goal_funding_sources"."mode" <> 'whole') and ("goal_funding_sources"."pct_bps" is null or "goal_funding_sources"."pct_bps" between 1 and 10000)

goals_target_months_check.name: goals_target_months_check
goals_target_months_check.value: ("goals"."target_mode" = 'monthly_expenses') = ("goals"."target_months" is not null) and ("goals"."target_months" is null or "goals"."target_months" between 1 and 24)

instance_settings_smtp_check.name: instance_settings_smtp_check
instance_settings_smtp_check.value: ("instance_settings"."smtp_host" is null) = ("instance_settings"."smtp_port" is null) and ("instance_settings"."smtp_host" is null) = ("instance_settings"."smtp_from" is null) and ("instance_settings"."smtp_host" is not null or ("instance_settings"."smtp_username" is null and "instance_settings"."smtp_password_enc" is null))

instance_settings_smtp_password_check.name: instance_settings_smtp_password_check
instance_settings_smtp_password_check.value: "instance_settings"."smtp_password_enc" is null or "instance_settings"."instance_dek_wrapped" is not null

investment_trades_units_check.name: investment_trades_units_check
investment_trades_units_check.value: case "investment_trades"."kind" when 'adjust' then "investment_trades"."units" <> 0 when 'dividend' then "investment_trades"."units" >= 0 when 'cash_topup' then "investment_trades"."units" = 0 else "investment_trades"."units" > 0 end

investment_trades_amounts_check.name: investment_trades_amounts_check
investment_trades_amounts_check.value: "investment_trades"."fee_minor" >= 0 and "investment_trades"."tax_minor" >= 0 and case "investment_trades"."kind" when 'adjust' then "investment_trades"."amount_minor" = 0 when 'sell' then "investment_trades"."amount_minor" >= 0 else "investment_trades"."amount_minor" > 0 end

receivables_written_off_check.name: receivables_written_off_check
receivables_written_off_check.value: ("receivables"."status" = 'written_off') = ("receivables"."written_off_at" is not null) and ("receivables"."writeoff_transaction_id" is null or "receivables"."status" = 'written_off')

recurrences_end_check.name: recurrences_end_check
recurrences_end_check.value: ("recurrences"."end_type" = 'after') = ("recurrences"."end_count" is not null) and ("recurrences"."end_count" is null or "recurrences"."end_count" between 1 and 999)

reports_kind_status_check.name: reports_kind_status_check
reports_kind_status_check.value: ("reports"."kind" = 'monthly' and "reports"."status" = 'final' and "reports"."period_id" is not null) or ("reports"."kind" <> 'monthly' and "reports"."status" = 'provisional' and "reports"."period_id" is null)

reports_compare_check.name: reports_compare_check
reports_compare_check.value: ("reports"."compare_start" is null) = ("reports"."compare_end" is null) and ("reports"."compare_start" is null or "reports"."compare_start" <= "reports"."compare_end")

scheduled_occurrences_remind_at_idx.name: scheduled_occurrences_remind_at_idx
scheduled_occurrences_remind_at_idx.where: "scheduled_occurrences"."reminded_at" is null and "scheduled_occurrences"."remind_at" is not null

subscriptions_paused_check.name: subscriptions_paused_check
subscriptions_paused_check.value: ("subscriptions"."status" = 'paused') = ("subscriptions"."paused_until" is not null and "subscriptions"."paused_on" is not null)

subscriptions_cancelled_check.name: subscriptions_cancelled_check
subscriptions_cancelled_check.value: ("subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("subscriptions"."ends_on" is not null and "subscriptions"."cancel_mode" is not null and "subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null)

transfer_meta_rate_check.name: transfer_meta_rate_check
transfer_meta_rate_check.value: ("transfer_meta"."reference_rate" is null) = ("transfer_meta"."rate_base" is null) and ("transfer_meta"."reference_rate" is null) = ("transfer_meta"."rate_quote" is null) and ("transfer_meta"."reference_rate" is null or "transfer_meta"."reference_rate" > 0)
